notes.title: Rulers of Valendor!
notes.notes:
[p]On September 27, the 3rd Act of your reign will be released. Based on the experience of launching the previous act, I’d like to highlight a few points and make some announcements:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Bug fixes.[/b]
During the first ten days after release, I will be actively fixing issues based on your feedback. Act III has a huge amount of branching, and some event chains may not work as intended. I tested everything thoroughly, but in Act II I was still receiving critical reports from you for almost a month. So, if you don’t want to take part in “forced beta-testing,” you may want to wait about 10 more days before playing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Voice-over.[/b]
The game now features two versions of voice-over in both Russian and English: narrated and machine. However, the narrated English version will not yet be available for Act III and will be added a bit later.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimization.[/b]
The game has already grown quite large — partly due to the voice-overs and also more than a thousand images. After releasing Act III and fixing the most important issues, I will focus on internal optimization. You won’t notice visual changes, but without this step it will be difficult to release Act IV: sound conflicts are already appearing due to the project’s earlier architecture.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual effects.[/b]
As usual, visual effects will be added to Act III gradually.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New buildings.[/b]
Three new buildings have been added to the game. They will come with their own quests and events, but these will be released later as a separate update.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reminder.[/b]
The game is still in Early Access. I’ll be very grateful for any errors you find — including grammar mistakes. Your feedback and comments are truly inspiring, and when my kids read them — that’s a special joy for me.[/p][/*][/olist][p]⚠️ [b]Important note.[/b]
I can’t give you an exact release time for Act III, since Steam performs periodic checks on large updates, and this can cause delays.[/p]

notes.title: Release date of Act III
notes.notes: [p]By royal decree, I hereby announce the release date of Act III — September 27. I understand that a 28-day delay from the schedule is not the most pleasant event in the life of the kingdom, but it’s better to polish and test everything thoroughly than to roll out Tenebris’s raw excrements.[/p]

notes.title: Russian voice actor Sergey Mayski’s video message to the players
notes.notes: [p]As you may know, the game recently introduced two voiceover options — a professional actor’s version and a machine-generated one (in English and Russian versions). However, some Russian players believe that the actor’s voiceover was created by AI. To address these doubts, Russian voice actor Sergey Mayski recorded a short video message in which he greets the players and explains how to tell a genuine performance from an AI-generated one. The video is in Russian:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Tr3SHNpI7yg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Voiceover Update and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]A big hello from Valendor! Today I'm rolling out an update that’s large in size but not in the number of fixes: you can now choose between narrated and machine voiceover for quests and events in both the English and Russian versions. Please note that the second chapter hasn’t yet been recorded by the narrator, but I’ll be uploading this update later this week.[/p][p]I’ve also fixed a bug that prevented achievements from being awarded. This week I’ll announce the exact release date for Act III, it will definitely come out in September, but there’s still plenty of cleanup to do with errors and bugs.[/p]

notes.title: The demo is now available!
notes.notes: [p]In the Kingdom of Valendor, things rarely go in order. Two full acts with at least 12 hours of thoughtful gameplay have already been released, yet the demo was still missing. Today we’ve fixed that! Now you can try on the crown in the demo version of the game. It includes 15 turns of gameplay. Start ruling today![/p]

notes.title: Replacement of the English voice-over
notes.notes: [p][b]A big update[/b] for everyone playing with the English voice-over! The entire first act has been completely re-voiced by [url="https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197994324310/"]Wolenard[/url]. And just listen to how he sings there![/p][p]The voice-over for the second act is already on the way![/p]

notes.title: Try yourself in the role of an inquisitor
notes.notes: [p]You are an inquisitor in the service of the formidable Tomás de Torquemada. Interrogate suspects, send heretics to the stake, perform exorcism rituals, and banish demons. Every wrong decision brings you closer to your own execution, and a demon banished incorrectly may devour you entirely. Build your monastery, investigate cases, make fateful decisions, and become a great inquisitor![/p][p]You can support the author by adding the game to your wishlist right now [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3953700/Your_Judgement_Inquisitor/"]via the link.[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228587/0274fd0b591ed096fbd2fefd89455d4c8ce8410d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]IMPORTANT![/b] I will not start working on the script until I finish [i]The Succession of Changing Kings[/i]. All plans stated in the project’s roadmap remain unchanged: Acts 3 and 4 will be released this year. And very soon, a demo version will be available for the 22,000 people who have wishlisted the game but haven’t yet decided to try it.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3953700/Your_Judgement_Inquisitor/" style="button"]Wishlist now[/url][/p]

notes.title: Frosty greetings from Valendor!
notes.notes:
As promised, on May 31st, the Second Act of your reign is being released. The key question this time: will you manage to avoid war—and if so, at what cost? Or perhaps you’ll choose to enter the fray and show those arrogant southerners what Valendor men (and ladies!) are made of?

Even though the act is launching today, there’s still plenty of work ahead, and I’m counting on your help. After the release of the First Act, I received tons of valuable feedback on balance, visual effects, and bugs. So, if you’d prefer not to become an accidental beta tester, I recommend waiting about 10–12 days before diving into Act Two.

Now, a few important points I’d like to highlight:

—It’s currently not possible to start directly from Act Two after your character dies on Normal or Death! difficulty levels. Fixing this is a top priority, and I’ll address it soon.

—A new mechanic has been introduced: temporary “servant lockout.” For example, if you send a detective on a distant journey, he becomes temporarily unavailable for other quests. I’ve already found a couple of bugs related to this, but fixing them now would significantly delay the release.

—There are technical conflicts between some quests that I haven’t yet resolved. I expect to fix these within a couple of days.

—As mentioned earlier, I’ll be actively working on game balance adjustments in the coming days, so I’d really appreciate your feedback, suggestions, and comments.

—Huge thanks to everyone for your patience, kind words, and constructive criticism!

And now — the throne is all yours!

notes.title: Act II is almost here: return to Valendor on May 31st!
notes.notes:
You’ve been away from the throne for a while, but the kingdom needs you once again. A harsh winter has brought suffering and strife, and your southern neighbor is sharpening swords and stringing bows — war is looming.
Can you emerge victorious in the upcoming battle? Or perhaps avoid it altogether?
It all depends on your choices and... the will of Lumen.

[list]
[*] You’ll reunite with familiar faces: the enigmatic Alestra, the cunning Troy, the reckless adventurer Filler Brashbill, the poet-baron I’Vald, the insufferable diplomat Cardos Mirvald Zutaba Artarion, and all the faction leaders.
[*] Over 200 new quests and events.
[*] A chance to avoid war and trigger a completely alternate storyline.
[*] More than 6 distinct paths to victory in the war.
[*] And, of course, two dozen new ways to die.
[/list]

With the release of Act II, prices in some regions will increase by 10-15%. Get it now at the current price!
